content.text: All eight preferred elements are present in §§ 22.1–22.2; no other audit/inspection right binds Customer.

input.quote: 22.1 Vendor may audit Customer's compliance with licence quantities no more than once in any twelve-month period, on at least thirty days' prior written notice, during normal business hours, and in a manner that does not unreasonably disrupt Customer. An audit will be conducted off-site where practicable by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality.
input.rationale: Section 22 is the only audit right binding Customer (Section 23 contains no operative assurance obligation, and no other verification, inspection or remote-monitoring right appears in the document). It meets every element of our preferred position: audits are limited to once in any twelve-month period, on at least thirty days' prior written notice, during normal business hours, off-site where practicable, by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality (§ 22.1); Vendor bears costs unless the audit establishes underpayment exceeding five percent, and Vendor and its auditor may not access Customer systems directly (§ 22.2). Section 22.3 further protects us by making findings Customer Confidential Information. No redline is warranted.
